jobs.title: EI&C Software Application Engineer
jobs.description:
SEARGIN IS HIRING!

As a dynamic multinational tech company operating in 50 countries, we drive innovation and create projects that shape the future and greatly enhance the quality of life. You will find our solutions supporting advanced AI initiatives, financial analytics, and enterprise-scale digital transformation across global organisations.

About the role

We are looking for an EI&C / Automation Software Engineer who will be responsible for developing, integrating and maintaining software solutions used in manufacturing and automation environments.
The role combines software development, industrial automation, IT/OT integration and system support. You will work with systems such as DCS, MES, data historians and databases, ensuring reliable data exchange and smooth operation of manufacturing applications.

Responsibilities

Develop, configure and maintain software applications supporting manufacturing and automation processes
Design and implement integrations between DCS, MES, historians, databases and other manufacturing systems
Develop solutions using C#, SQL, PowerShell and VBA
Support interfaces and data exchange between IT and OT environments
Troubleshoot software and system issues and perform root cause analysis
Test, commission, qualify and deploy software solutions
Maintain and improve existing applications to increase reliability, performance and usability
Prepare technical, functional and software design documentation in accordance with GMP/GxP and company standards
Support software validation, change management and version control activities
Ensure compliance with data integrity and cybersecurity requirements
Work closely with Automation, Manufacturing, Validation, Quality and IT teams throughout the project lifecycle

Requirements – Must Have

University degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, IT or a related field
Strong IT background with knowledge of software development, databases, networking and system integration
Professional experience with automation or manufacturing systems, such as DCS, MES or data historian platforms
Good knowledge of C#, SQL, PowerShell and/or VBA
Experience with software lifecycle management and application support
Previous experience working in a GMP/GxP-regulated environment
Experience creating technical and GxP-compliant documentation
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
Fluent English and/or German

Nice to Have

Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology or life sciences manufacturing
Knowledge of DeltaV, Syncade, PI System or similar industrial platforms
Experience with software validation, CSV/CSA methodologies and data integrity
Understanding of OT infrastructure and cybersecurity
Experience with Git or other version control systems

Key Skills

Software Development & Application Support
DCS / MES Integration
SQL & Database Management
C# / PowerShell / VBA
IT/OT Integration
GMP/GxP Documentation
Software Validation & Testing
Commissioning & Deployment
Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis
Change Management & Version Control

Role in simple terms

This is a software-focused automation role. You will act as a bridge between IT and industrial automation, developing and supporting applications that communicate with manufacturing systems such as DCS and MES.
The ideal candidate is therefore not only a traditional automation/PLC engineer, but someone who also has a strong software and IT background, particularly in programming, databases and system integration.

Contact
: kamil.michalik@seargin.com

Discover the Power of IT Excellence. Apply!

To learn more about Seargin, please visit our web page: www.seargin.com

jobs.title: Graduate Engineer im IT-Consulting (100%)
jobs.description:
Du hast gerade dein Studium abgeschlossen und schon zehn Jahre Erfahrung als Senior Engineer? Just kidding. We hire for attitude and train for skills. Du bringst Drive, Freude am Kundenkontakt, ein Herz für Tech und den Kopf für komplexe Probleme mit - den Rest bringen wir dir bei. Wer "wir" sind? Eine Schweizer IT-Consulting-Firma mit über 270 Mitarbeitenden. Seit 1996 entwickeln wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden in der Deutschschweiz digitale Lösungen, die halten, was sie versprechen.

Deine Challenges

Du arbeitest in einem Projektteam beim Kunden, gemeinsam mit dessen Mitarbeitenden und weiteren ipt’lern
Du entwickelst hands-on individuelle Lösungen rund um Cloud, API Management, Fullstack Applikationen oder Datenplattformen
Dabei arbeitest du mit führenden Technologien wie Microsoft Azure, AWS, Confluent oder Databricks
Dein erstes ipt-Projekt suchen wir gemeinsam mit dir, passend zu deinen Interessen und Stärken

Das bringst du mit

Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik
Erste technische Praxiserfahrung ist ein Plus, sei es durch einen Job oder durch Studienprojekte
Du gehst mit Biss an Herausforderungen, die andere lieber liegen lassen
Professionelles Auftreten und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
Bereitschaft, 1 bis 3 Mal pro Woche vor Ort beim Kunden zu arbeiten (Zürich, Bern, Luzern, Basel)

Das sind unsere Benefits für dich

Klare Perspektive: Du willst in deiner Karriere weiterkommen? Bei ipt hast du jährlich die Chance, befördert zu werden. Unser Karrieremodell zeigt dir deine Möglichkeiten auf.
Keine Chefs: Bei ipt mögen wir es nicht nur technologisch modern. Wir haben nur eine einzige Hierarchiestufe und glauben an das Potenzial von lateraler Führung.
iEvent: Einmal im Jahr verreist die ganze ipt für fünf Tage ins Ausland, für gemeinsame Workshops und Fun-Aktivitäten.
Zeit für dich: Überstunden kannst du bei uns 1:1 kompensieren. Dazu hast du 6 Wochen Ferien.
Bring Your Own Device: Mit CHF 3000 Startguthaben holst du dir die Geräte, die zu dir passen. Danach wird dein Guthaben monatlich mit CHF 125 aufgefüllt.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (.NET & Vue/React) - Fully Remote, Canada Time
jobs.description:
Top 3 Reasons To Join Us

Competitive Salary
International Environment
Working on the latest tech for the Insurtech Market Leader

About Us

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone.

We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C
We're the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in all of Asia and other awards globally
We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more
We're an international, diverse team of over 120 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world
We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors
We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas
We've grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021
We're constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world

What You Will Do

Design, implement and maintain new features and functionalities for the SAAS platform, understanding the requirements of insurance businesses and translating them into scalable and efficient software solutions
Work on both the front-end and back-end of the application, demonstrating expertise in various technologies, frameworks, and programming languages
Work collaboratively with product, design, engineering teams, and UX designers to understand end-user requirements, use cases, and technical concepts, translating them into a cohesive and effective solution while ensuring a seamless user experience
Optimize the performance of the application to handle large amounts of data and high user traffic, delivering a smooth user experience
Participate in code reviews and enforce best coding practices, while also writing and executing unit tests and integration tests to maintain code quality
Investigate and promptly fix bugs to maintain the reliability of the platform
Ensure security and compliance by following best practices for securing web applications and adhering to relevant regulations in handling sensitive customer data
Stay up-to-date with the latest technologies, frameworks, and best practices to ensure we remain competitive and innovative
Design the platform with scalability and flexibility in mind, accommodating new features and changes as the number of clients and users grows
Provide mentorship to junior developers, aiding in their technical growth and effective contribution to the team's goals

What We Need

Proven experience 6 years as a Full Stack Engineer, working on complex SAAS applications
Strong technical background with proficiency in back-end technologies, such as .NET Core, C#, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker
Proficiency in front-end technologies such as Javascript, Vue.js and/or React.js
Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for building scalable applications
Experience with microservices and/or clean architecture
Thorough understanding and practical experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD) to ensure robust and well-tested code
Experience with unit, integration and function testing using front-end and back-end testing libraries
Proficiency in Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles to create a maintainable and modular architecture that aligns with business domains
In-depth knowledge of web security best practices and experience in ensuring compliance with industry regulations
Demonstrated experience in performance optimization for high-traffic web applications
Experience with container technologies like docker and good understanding of cloud infrastructure and solutions
Experience with agile development methodologies and collaborating with cross-functional teams
Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to troubleshooting and bug fixing
Strong communication skills to effectively interact with both technical and non-technical team members with diverse backgrounds
A passion for staying updated with the latest trends, technologies, and best practices in software development

Why You'll Love Working Here

Competitive renumeration package
International Environment
15 days annual leave, 10 sick leaves, special leaves
Annual Performance Bonus
Company activities and events
Learning and development plan
